== Biography ==

The Emperor is nickel-plated and kept free of rust by thousands of Winkies who polish his castle out of devotion to him. His people are described as loving to do anything in their power for their beloved Emperor. He maintains a Tin Cornet Band, which entertained guests one evening with several melodies after dinner.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Dorothy]]''' — friend. Their frequent appearance together suggests a friendly bond, though the excerpts do not detail its nature.

'''[[Ozma]]''' — ally. Their association could indicate an alliance, though this is not explicitly confirmed.

'''[[Roquat]]''' — enemy. Their opposition seems suggested by context, though not explicitly stated.

'''[[Wizard]]''' — friend. The Wizard's familiarity with the Emperor's castle and habits suggests a friendly acquaintance.
